scope: Honor initialized_size in compressed NTFS attribute reads.

implementation.reader: Clamp the caller-visible prefix before choosing raw or compressed I/O. Skip I/O for wholly uninitialized requests; zero the logical tail only after a successful initialized prefix.
implementation.errors: Existing extent I/O and LZNT1 decode failures still return None. Necessary whole-unit decompression is retained.
implementation.unchanged: Resident files, data_size EOF clamping, runlist validation, compression format and write restrictions. No API/ABI change.
implementation.diagnostic: Extend existing explicit CHECK NTFS with /INITIALIZED. Select only the disposable source-pinned NTFS4K derivative by an exact private file marker; read raw compressed units, real LZNT1, compressed sparse units, ordinary nonresident control and a malformed initialized LZNT1 prefix.
implementation.fixture: Spectra Tests/Prepare-NtfsInitialized.ps1 copies the existing SDK Windows NTFS4K reference without changing its archive; verifies the exact original SHA-256 and geometry before fixed record edits.

host_preflight.initial_start: QEMU rejected a read-only ide-hd block node before guest boot; serial output was empty.
host_preflight.resolution: Attach the disposable fixture writable, perform only reads and require its full pre/post SHA-256 to match. Reuse only the unbooted prepared media after exact source/work-copy hash checks.

performance_assessment: The normal NTFS read path changes, including compression and zero-tail I/O. Exactly one final Suite-2 STANDARD on SMP4 is required.
limits: The focused check needs an explicitly prepared disposable foreign NTFS fixture; it does not select or write an ordinary user volume.
No general NTFS write, foreign-volume catalog, physical hardware or Windows-host campaign is added.
Original full benchmark exports and raw samples remain outside Git.
